about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_tiny_models.py: tiny_vda.onnx on the synthetic video of vda_video_frame (28 x 28 eyes, model input 14 x 14, a cut at frame 37), the window loop of depth.py scene by scene in double precision. maps are the aligned maps of the frames, percentiles the smoothed p2 and p98 they are normalised with; windows gives the frame of each slot of each window of a scene of n frames.
